basis: Raid-first planning judgement for a selected Kariyan/Laviscus/Trajann lineup, not a measured damage ranking. Meet a current checkpoint's rarity gate first. Separate alliance orb pools can progress in parallel. First Mythic before optional extra Mythic stars.

reasons.Kariyan: First Imperial focus: damage and passive scaling support the whole damage sequence.
reasons.Laviscus: First Chaos focus: finisher damage, survivability and the Adamantine rank path. Ahead of Kharn for this Raid team.
reasons.Trajann: After Kariyan in the Imperial pool; prepare Mythic when pushing Commander beyond level 50.
reasons.Kharn: After Laviscus in the Chaos pool for Raid-first spending. Broader Arena/War use can justify a different personal order.
reasons.Gulgortz: Uses Xenos orbs independently; raise the team's damage core before prioritizing his late roadmap targets.
reasons.Vitruvius: Support after the damage core; follow the selected support checkpoints.
reasons.Aesoth: Support after the damage core; meet his earlier support targets first.
reasons.Dante: Support after the damage core; follow the selected support checkpoints.
reasons.Atlacoya: Selected flex after the damage core; precise Mythic priority needs more research.

timing.Kariyan: First Mythic: passive at 50 or ready to push beyond Diamond III.
timing.Laviscus: First Mythic: ready to push beyond Diamond III; earlier if survival blocks raids.
timing.Trajann: First Mythic: Commander at 50, then push its higher ability levels or Adamantine ranks.
timing.Kharn: First Mythic: after Laviscus in the Chaos pool, when pushing Adamantine ranks.
timing.Gulgortz: First Mythic: prepare Xenos resources in parallel for his later rank and passive targets.
